explanation.seed: Repeatable provisional grain and worn metal colouring; no gameplay RNG.
explanation.roof_subdivisions: Sampling density of the closed covering relief; same mesh at each measured distance.
explanation.roof_courses: Six overlapping-looking recessed courses per one-metre module.
explanation.roof_joint_depth_m: Maximum inward roof-course relief; cannot expand native roof collision.
explanation.roof_edge_guard_m: Exact uncut border retains all native roof seam endpoints and slopes.
explanation.join_depth_m: Backed door joinery, masonry cuts and blind fastener sockets.
explanation.join_width_m: Narrow physical panel joints; ordinary construction has no magical scars.
explanation.web_recess_m: Shallow metal web relief retains the solid-box girder silhouette and collision.
explanation.render_samples: CPU Blender inspection quality; not a game performance setting.
